card.name: Digits within decimal numbers before units
card.fires_on: A digit in a decimal number, usually just after the decimal point, right before a unit such as mSv, mL, mg, hours or million. Also fires on the word "one" in a spelled-out fraction before "percent".

modes.label: Decimal digits before a unit
modes.description: A digit after the decimal point in a measured value, followed by a unit like mSv, mGy, mL, mg or hours.
modes.example: 10 mCi is 5.0<<7>> mSv in an adult.

modes.label: Spelled-out fraction
modes.description: The word one in a fraction such as one-tenth of one percent.
modes.example: 000 m 3 per year, or about one-tenth of<< one>> percent of the annual harvest in BC.
